{{Top|title=''Victory''-class Star Destroyer}}
{{Otheruses|Victory}}
{{Quote|Too bad one ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer could fight her to a stand-still.|[[Kyle Katarn]] compares a ''Victory''-class to a [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class cruiser]]|audio=VictoryVsDreadnaught-DFSftE.flac|<ref name="DFaudio">[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
[[File:VictoryClassStarDestroyer-SWArmada.png|thumb|right|250px|A ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]]
The '''''Victory''-series''' of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] was a group of [[Warship/Legends|warship]] designs that consisted of two main sub-classes and several modifications to these.

The main two sub-classifications were:
*[[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|'''''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer''']]
*[[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|'''''Victory II''-class Star Destroyer''']]

Although referred to as Star Destroyers, their classification on the [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|Anaxes War College System]] was closer to that of a [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruiser]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Victory''-class Star Destroyers appeared in Hasbro's board game ''Star Wars: Electronic Galactic Battle'' as the game's equivalent to the cruiser piece in the game Battleship. However, in that game, the Victory Star Destroyer simply resembles a smaller version of the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer, instead of having its unique characteristics.
